name: The Girl Who Confessed to Me
source:
What would you do if the girl you like confessed her feelings to you, only to find out at that exact moment that she’s not actually a girl? 

This is what the main character will have to face.

He can’t bring himself to turn "her" down right after agreeing to date, even though he’s straight and not interested in that kind of relationship.

Not wanting to break his heart, he agrees to date him, planning to come up with a “break-up plan” later with the help of his best friend.

His idea is simple: act in a way that’ll make his new “girlfriend” lose interest in him and end things himself.

But will the main character really succeed?  

Or will his feelings change, as they spend time together and get to know each other better?

Only you can decide how this story unfolds...
